title: add vpc control plane provisioning (helm & terraform) + upgrade/rollback hooks for private installer
author: Priya Patel
commits: 7a1f3d2: add terraform module for control-plane vpc (subnets, route tables, nat gateways)
9b2e4c7: add interface endpoint module and support for aws_interface_endpoint mappings
c3d5a91: security group templates and least-privilege rules for control plane components
d4e6b2f: route53 private hosted zone support + cross-account peering records
e5f7c3a: helm chart values for private installer control-plane networking
f6a8d4b: add upgrade and rollback hooks to installer (preflight, drain, post-rollback)
g7b9e5c: add CI e2e tests and integration docs
description:
Motivation: private deployments require a reliable, auditable VPC provisioning path for the control plane that works across Hosted Dedicated and Private installer modes. This PR adds Terraform modules and Helm chart integrations to provision subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account peering, and Route53 private hosted zones. It also adds upgrade and rollback hooks to the private installer so upgrades can be orchestrated (preflight checks, safe drain, post-upgrade verification) and rolled back cleanly if regressions are detected.

What this changes: consolidated and tested Terraform modules under redwood-terraform/modules/control-plane-vpc; new interface endpoint and security-group templates; optional cross-account peering resource with Route53 peering zone associations; Helm values and templates in redwood-helm-charts/private-installer to wire networking resources into the control-plane chart; installer lifecycle hooks (pre-upgrade validation, node drain hook, post-rollback reconciliation) and corresponding e2e tests.

Compatibility notes: modules are opt-in via variables so existing private-installer users are unaffected. Cross-account peering is gated by a variable and requires explicit trust configuration (documented). Route53 changes only create private hosted zones when the feature flag is enabled.

Testing: added unit tests for Terraform modules (terraform validate + plan with mocked backends), helm lint and template unit checks, and an integration test that runs the installer against a dedicated test VPC in our staging AWS account. CI initially reported a flaky e2e - I re-ran the job after tightening a retry window on the installer hooks; all checks passed on the final run.

Related: links to Linear tasks ENG-4219 and INF-1024 for rollout and post-deploy observability work.

Notes: this PR is intentionally scoped to infrastructure + installer orchestration; runtime/kernel-level serving changes will come in a follow-up.
release_notes:
- Add Terraform module: control-plane-vpc (subnets, IGW/NAT, route tables)
- Add Terraform module: interface endpoints and SGs for control plane services
- Add optional cross-account VPC peering and Route53 peering zone association support
- Helm chart: control-plane networking values and templates for private-installer
- Installer: upgrade and rollback lifecycle hooks (preflight, drain, post-rollback reconciliation)
- Integration tests and documentation for VPC provisioning and upgrade flow
review_comments: Evan Zhang: please tighten the security group egress rules - we should not open 0.0.0.0/0 for control plane nodes. Updated and added a test for SG egress.
Priya Patel: replaced the broad egress rule with specific endpoints and added a variable to opt-in for wider access. Added note in README.

Maria Gonzales: can we gate cross-account peering behind a feature flag? we don't want accidental peering in onboarding. Priya: added variable 'enable_cross_account_peering' and documented requirements.
Ravi Sundaram: CI e2e was flaky due to timing in the drain hook. Suggest adding a configurable retry + timeout. Priya: added retry logic and increased readiness checks; reran e2e which passed.
notes_for_release: This PR enables optional VPC provisioning for the private control plane. Operators should review the new variables in the terraform module and helm values before enabling in production. Follow docs/private-installer/vpc-provisioning.md for upgrade steps and rollback procedures.
